column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted  are  hereby  declared  to  be  –

column2: to  carry  the    message  and  teachings  of  Bhagavan
Sri Sathya Sai Baba ;
to promote through practice and example the basic

principles 
of 
Sathya 
(Truth), 
Dharma
(Righteousness),  Shanthi  (Peace),  Prema  (Love)
and Ahimsa (Non Violence) set by Bhagawan Sri
Sathya Sai Baba ;
to promote the  knowledge of Vedas, Upanishads,
Shastras, Purans and other literature of the Sanathana
Dharma ;
to  promote  the  study  of  the  Noble,  sublime  and
highest  ethical  principles  of  all  great  religions  of
the world and the spirituallty which is the true basis
of all such religions ;
to promote inter-religious harmony ;
to  promote  peace  and  goodwill  among  mankind  ;
to provide scholarships to deserving students at any
school, college, university or any Institute approved
by  the  Trust ;
to  assist  needy  students  by  providing  books,
instruments, apparel, loans and grants in cash ;
to conduct study classes, lectures, seminars, study-
tours  and  engage  in  such  other  activities  as  may
promote the advancement of education ;
to provide homes for the needy and indigent, aged
and  disabled  and  orphan  children  ;
